name: What types of trim are included in custom molding work?

mainEntity.name: What types of trim are included in custom molding work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom molding work covers decorative and functional interior trim crafted or fitted to your home's exact dimensions. Common styles include crown molding along ceiling transitions, baseboards along floors, door and window casings, chair rails, picture rails, and wainscoting or board-and-batten wall paneling. In older Denver-area homes, custom millwork is often required to replicate historical profiles that modern lumberyards do not stock in off-the-shelf bundles. HH Remodeling handles custom profile selection, framing preparation, precise mitered or coped joint cutting, nail fastening, caulking, and finishing coats of interior paint to achieve seamless transitions across uneven walls.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom molding includes crown molding, baseboards, door and window casings, chair rails, and wainscoting designed to fit your home's specific wall and ceiling profiles.
